chain.label: DNA synthesizer shipped as general freight with undeclared flammable chemicals after incomplete purge
chain.trigger: the field engineer probably failed to sufficiently empty one or more of the internal reagent bottles after the flushing process and before the drying cycle

chain.label: In-flight cargo fire of undetermined origin in the main deck cabin cargo compartment
chain.trigger: the probable cause of this accident was an in-flight cargo fire of undetermined origin

caused_by.evidence: These volatile chemicals—particularly the THF—could ignite a fire... however, it could not be determined whether the chemicals in the synthesizer played any role in igniting the fire

chain.label: Captain failed to call for, assign, and monitor emergency checklist duties; flight engineer left overloaded
chain.trigger: the captain did not adequately manage his crew resources when he failed to call for checklists or to monitor and facilitate the accomplishment of required checklist items

caused_by.evidence: the flight engineer was overloaded and distracted from his attempts to accomplish the “Fire & Smoke” and “Cabin Cargo Smoke Light Illuminated” emergency checklists

chain.label: Cabin air shutoff T-handle never pulled, leaving cabin airflow feeding the cargo deck fire
chain.trigger: the flight engineer’s failure to pull the cabin air shutoff T-handle... allowed the normal circulation of air to continue to enter the main cargo area, thereby providing the fire with a continuing source of oxygen and contributing to its rapid growth

caused_by.evidence: The captain also did not recognize the flight engineer’s failure to accomplish required checklist items, provide the flight engineer with effective assistance, or intervene to adjust or prioritize his workload

chain.label: Outflow valve cranked only two turns; airplane not depressurized before landing
chain.trigger: instead of manually maintaining the appropriate pressure differential, after he had placed the outflow valve control in the manual position, he only “cranked it open a couple of times [turns]”

caused_by.evidence: the captain did not initiate the “Emergency Evacuation” checklist... it would have provided another opportunity for the crew to accomplish the necessary depressurization

chain.label: L1 exit door air-bottle pressure bled off; door only partially opened and evacuation was delayed
chain.trigger: The L-1 door was not available as an emergency exit because it only opened partially as a result of the flight engineer’s attempt to open the door while the airplane was still pressurized

caused_by.evidence: the occupants were unable to immediately open and exit from the primary evacuation exits (the L1 and R1 doors) because the airplane was still pressurized

chain.label: Inadequate means for extinguishing an aircraft interior cargo fire; no on-board suppression for the main deck
chain.trigger: currently, inadequate means exist for extinguishing on-board aircraft fires

chain.label: Emergency landing at Stewart International Airport
chain.trigger: made an emergency landing at Stewart International Airport, Newburgh, New York, after the flightcrew determined that there was smoke in the cabin cargo compartment

caused_by.evidence: we’ve definitely got smoke guys…we need to get down right now, let’s go

chain.label: Airplane and most of its cargo destroyed by the post-landing fire
chain.trigger: The airplane was destroyed by fire after the landing

caused_by.evidence: flames burned through the top of the fuselage... firefighting efforts continued until approximately 0925, when the fire was extinguished
The growth of the fire was likely affected by the failure to pull the cabin air shutoff T-handle
the cargo net and the forward cargo containers blocked their access to the cargo compartment... use of the SPAAT tool to penetrate the fuselage was delayed

chain.label: Captain and flight engineer sustained minor injuries during the evacuation
chain.trigger: During the evacuation, the captain sustained rope burns on his hands, and the flight engineer received a minor cut to his forehead

caused_by.evidence: The captain and the first officer then evacuated the airplane using the cockpit windows’ escape ropes
the smoke was “oily and sooty” and acrid smelling, and that it made breathing unpleasant and difficult
